evidence: Matches Utils/log/libs label and directly modifies logging and argument handling in src/common/args.cpp.
rationale: Fixes a security and privacy issue where sensitive configuration options loaded from settings.json are printed in cleartext to debug.log and console output. As noted in the PR description, ArgsManager::LogArgs masks SENSITIVE options from CLI and bitcoin.conf, but prints m_settings.rw_settings values verbatim, exposing secrets such as rpcpassword, rpcauth, or torpassword.
